title: Help Scout vs. Intercom vs. Front: Find the right fit for your customer operations
summary: Compare Help Scout vs. Intercom vs. Front across AI, channels, collaboration, reporting, pricing, and B2B operations to find the right fit for your team.
body_markdown:
Platform


Best fit for


Customer conversations and channels

Help Scout


Support-focused teams that want a clear, straightforward setup


Email, live chat, help center, limited in-app messaging


AI answers, workflows, routing with human oversight


Shared inboxes, assignments, internal notes


Intercom


Teams that want AI-driven, chat-based deflection for routine queries


Chat, app messages, email, product tours, in-app support


AI agent, chatbots, automation across the customer journey


Collaboration inside conversations, customer timelines


Front


B2B organizations with cross-team customer work


Email, chat, SMS, social media, shared inboxes


AI-assisted triage, routing, knowledge base suggestions


Cross-team coordination, shared context, clear ownership
